claims.text: The GPS trace measures 14.37 km along the driven polyline between the recorded pickup at 06:30:55 and the recorded dropoff at 06:49:35, against a booking-time platform optimal of 11.0 km on the trip record. That is an excess of 3.37 km, equal to 30.64% of the optimal distance, and both POL-RD-01 gates are cleared: 30.64% is greater than 20%, and 3.37 km is greater than the 0.8 km absolute floor. The route deviation is ESTABLISHED. Under POL-RD-01 the governing field is gps_trace.trace_distance_km; trip_record.actual_distance_km (14.4) is a rounded convenience copy and may not be cited for the threshold test.

The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07. It carries 113 fixes at a 10 second sample interval across 100.0% coverage of the trip, with an empty gaps array and a max_gap_sec of 0.0. There is therefore no gap of more than 90 seconds, no straight-line jump of more than 500 m and no sustained interval above 30 seconds, so limbs (a) to (c) are not met, the deviation may be established on the trace alone, no independent corroboration is required, and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation route is not engaged.

The rider has discharged the POL-RD-08 initial burden on both limbs: the trip_record, the gps_trace and the fare_breakdown all carry trip identifier TRP-03102 and agree on the pickup event at 06:30:55, and the excess clears the POL-RD-01 threshold on an unimpaired trace. The burden therefore shifts to the driver, who must point to a specific artifact and a specific clause if he wishes to invoke POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12. A general assertion that traffic was bad, citing no artifact, does not discharge that burden.

The driver's answer, 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road. The fare is what the meter says.', asserts an external traffic cause but names no evidence ID and no traffic advisory. The bundle holds no advisory covering this trip window: EV-ADVIS-03102-01 is MISSING, carries no payload, has weight_multiplier 0.0 and fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - I disclose that impairment. Because the artifact is absent, the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run at all (no named segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window, no leave-and-rejoin check), so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and under POL-RD-13 and POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight, reduces no excess and supplies no amended optimal. Because the driver cites no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) applies: this is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact within POL-RD-10(5), and the case does not escalate on that ground.

POL-RD-04 cannot be invoked on this record. The chat log for TRP-03102 holds zero messages (message_count 0, an empty messages array, truncated false), so there is no rider instruction, no instruction timestamp and no chat_message.waypoint_hint capable of corroboration by the trace. No distance is excluded from the excess on the ground of a rider-requested detour or additional stop.

No pickup or dropoff amendment occurred. Both pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run and no post-booking re-quote displaces the baseline. The excess is measured against the correct endpoint pair and the booked optimal of 11.0 km.

The trip is not a pooled trip. The vehicle type on the trip record is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, and solo_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and no co-rider collection or set-down distance is in play. The POL-RD-01 baseline is therefore the platform optimal of 11.0 km recorded at booking.

The fare model on the payments ledger is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 (upfront-quoted fares) does not apply and the distance-and-time refund route is open rather than closed; the money question is governed by the POL-RD-02 arithmetic.

Recomputed fare under POL-RD-02, running on the booked optimal route: ((3.80 + 0.75 x 11.0 + 0.28 x 14.9) x 1.0 surge, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP and tolls + 0.00 waiting_time_fee - 0.00 promo discount = 17.022. Charged_total is 20.64. Refund = 20.64 - 17.022 = 3.618, rounded UP to SGD 3.65. That figure is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis threshold and is 17.5% of charged_total, below the 90% full-refund share, so the remedy on the rider's claim is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.65, with charged_total, recomputed_fare and refund stated on separate lines.

There is no ERP or toll line on this fare to itemise or add: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00, and both the off-optimal-route and on-optimal-route ERP totals are 0.00, and the airport surcharge is 0.00. Nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 refund under POL-RD-09(1), and no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) arises.

The rider's own profile does not raise the corroboration bar. rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 1, below the 4-or-more trigger in POL-RD-08, with deviation_claims_60d_substantiated at 0; and in any event the excess here is 30.64%, at or above the 30% line, on an unimpaired trace, so the proviso could not bite. POL-GEN-01 confines these profile fields to the test that names them and they are not used here for anything else.

The deviation is ESTABLISHED but not MATERIAL: 30.64% is below the 50% limb and 3.37 km is below the 8.0 km limb, and the driver's trailing-90-day deviation_flags_90d stands at 0 against 231 completed_trips_90d, which is far below either POL-RD-06 pattern trigger. The rider does not overreach by seeking the POL-RD-06(b) uplift to a full refund; the entitlement is the arithmetic POL-RD-02 partial refund above.

On this rider-filed dispute, NO_ACTION is party-relative and would be a loss for the rider: payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so leaving the present state as it is would leave the whole 20.64 with the rider, including the 3.37 km of detour distance the rider never asked for. The outcome that leaves the rider not carrying the disputed detour charge is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 3.65.

All three artifacts that carry the deciding facts - the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown - are COMPLETE with weight_multiplier 1.0, so under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap on this ruling is 1.0, above the 0.70 platform-wide floor. No POL-RD-10(1) escalation arises from the evidence the ruling rests on.

claims.text: On the governing figure the deviation is established but it is not a MATERIAL one. POL-RD-01 requires the trace figure, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km is 14.37 km against a booked optimal of 11.0 km — an excess of 3.37 km, 30.64% of optimal. That clears the establishment gates (>20% and >0.8 km) but falls short of BOTH materiality gates in the same clause: it is not greater than 50% of optimal and not greater than 8.0 km. The POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is therefore not engaged on this trip, and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift nor the driver-conduct referral that limb (b) and limb (c) of POL-RD-06 attach to a MATERIAL deviation can follow. The rounded convenience copy (trip_record.actual_distance_km = 14.4) may not be substituted for the trace figure under POL-RD-01.

The only two driver-profile fields POL-RD-06 permits show no repeat-deviation pattern whatsoever: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 231 — a ratio of 0.0, below the 0.05 test, and far below the 3-flag test. There is accordingly no basis for resolving any finely balanced point against the driver, no uplift on the remedy, and no referral. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags (1) and the rating (4.92) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure the clause names.

Whatever the outcome, the remedy is arithmetic and bounded, not the fare the rider actually paid. Reading the surge multiplier off the fare_breakdown (1.0) and the meter constants (base 3.80, 0.75/km, 0.28/min, 0.80 platform fee), the recomputed fare over the 11.0 km / 14.9 min optimal is 17.0220 against a charged_total of 20.64, giving a refund of 3.6180 rounded UP to 3.65. That is 17.5% of charged_total, nowhere near the 90% share POL-RD-02 requires before FULL_REFUND is substituted for a partial. The ceiling on the rider's recovery is therefore a PARTIAL_REFUND of 3.65 — and the rider's own amount in dispute on this dispute record is 3.00.

This is a metered trip, not an upfront-quoted one, so the rider's framing of a price 'the app quoted' does not hold: fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null. POL-RD-11 has no application, and the '11.0' the rider refers to is a route-distance estimate, not a fixed price for the journey. The amount the driver was entitled to meter therefore stands subject only to the POL-RD-02 recomputation; the rider cannot recover the whole 20.64 on a quotation theory.

Nothing on the ledger increases the rider's recovery. erp_lines is empty with a 0.00 total (no gantry on or off the optimal route), airport_surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that did not originate at an airport, waiting_time_fee is 0.00 and promo_discount is 0.00, so there is no phantom line, no wrongly applied surcharge and no billing-integrity defect under POL-RD-09(4), and no pass-through correction exists to be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare lines reconcile to the meter for the distance and time actually driven.

The driver does not pretend to an exculpatory clause the record cannot support, and says so plainly. The traffic advisory for this trip is MISSING — EV-ADVIS-03102-01 carries no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — so POL-RD-03 cannot be run for want of the advisory POL-RD-03 requires; the chat log holds 0 messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot be run; no pickup_amended_at or dropoff_amended_at is recorded and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; and vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's explanation that traffic was heavy is therefore an assertion unsupported by an advisory, and under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence ID discharges nothing.

The trace itself is clean, so nothing in POL-RD-10 fires and no amount is held: 113 fixes at a 10 s sample interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec of 0.0 mean the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c), the excess is measured from an unimpaired trace as POL-RD-08 requires, and no escalation trigger in POL-RD-10(1)–(8) is engaged. In particular POL-RD-13(1) keeps the driver's uncited traffic explanation out of POL-RD-10(5), because a party that names no advisory identifier cannot be said to invoke an exculpatory clause against a cited artifact; the case accordingly resolves on the POL-RD-02 arithmetic and on nothing else.

ruling.explanation: Finding on the core fact. Both advocates are right about the measurement, and the deviation is established. The GPS trace for TRP-03102 (EV-GPS-03102, weight 1.0) covers 100.0% of the trip with 113 fixes at a 10-second interval, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec 0.0, so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c) and no independent corroboration or POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. It measures 14.37 km between the recorded pickup (06:30:55) and the recorded drop-off (06:49:35), against the booking-time optimal of 11.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-03102, weight 1.0). Excess = 3.37 km = 30.64% of optimal, which clears both POL-RD-01 gates (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km). As POL-RD-01 requires, the governing figure is the trace's 14.37 km; the trip record's 14.4 km is a rounded convenience copy and was not used for the threshold test. The rider's claims on the measurement and on trace integrity are accepted, and the driver's concessions of the same points are accepted as far as they go. The driver's claim repeating that no POL-RD-10 trigger fires was discarded at the mechanical stage for not naming the advisory's issue code; the rider's independent claim to the same effect survives and is what I rely on. Not material. 30.64% is below the 50% limb and 3.37 km is below the 8.0 km limb, so this is not a MATERIAL deviation. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check is therefore not required, and it would not help in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 231, below both POL-RD-06 triggers. There is no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). I have not used the driver's lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags or the driver's rating: under POL-GEN-01 both are context only. The driver's traffic explanation. 'Traffic was heavy so I took another road' does not reduce the excess. The only traffic advisory for this trip, EV-ADVIS-03102-01, is MISSING - no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - so POL-RD-03 cannot be run (no named segment the optimal route traverses, no validity window, no leave-and-rejoin check), and under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight, reduces no distance and supplies no amended optimal. Because no advisory identifier was cited in support of an exculpatory clause, POL-RD-13(1) applies and this is not an escalation under POL-RD-10(5).
